pageSummary.title: Page Summary
pageSummary.description: A concise overview of the page's main content, topics, and key information to provide quick understanding of the page.

keyPhrases.title: Key Phrases
keyPhrases.description: A collection of significant phrases and terms extracted from the content that represent the main concepts, topics, or themes discussed in the page.

entities.title: Entities
entities.description: A collection of named entities identified in the content, such as people, organizations, locations, dates, products, or other specific items of interest.
